title: Ọkụ dị n'ime obí eze nke mpako
intro: N'azụ mgbidi ukwu nke obí eze kachasị ike n'ụwa ochie, e nwere otu onye obi ya zoro ezo nke iwu eze na-enweghị ike imechi. Mgbe gburugburu ya na-akpọrọ chi ụgha isiala, mkpụrụ obi a nọgidere na-enwe okwukwe dị jụụ n'ime ya. Onye ọchịchị nke ala ahụ kwenyere na ya bụ chi, mana onye a họọrọ eziokwu karịa nkasi obi, na nraranye karịa nchekwa. Taa, ọrụ gị bụ ịchọpụta onye mkpụrụ obi a nwere obi ike bụ, onye akụkọ ya ka bụ otu n'ime ihe atụ kachasị ike nke okwukwe na-adịghị agbanwe agbanwe.
clues: Ebi m n'ebe nwere nnukwu akụnụba na nnukwu ebube, ebe onye na-achị ala ahụ nwere ike zuru oke n'elu ihe niile.
Mgbe ndị gbara m gburugburu na-akpọrọ chi ụgha isiala, m tinyere ìhè dị jụụ nke okwukwe n'ime obi m.
Ahụrụ m ma zụlite otu nwatakịrị nke e ji ụzọ pụrụ iche kpọtaara m - ọ bụghị site n'ọmụmụ, kama site na mmiri nke nnukwu osimiri.
Ekpere m Onyenwe m, na-arịọ maka ebe obibi dị ya nso na Paradaịs na nzọpụta site n'aka ọchịchị aka ike gbara m gburugburu.
Nwatakịrị m zụlitere toro iji maa onye ọchịchị ahụ nke na-achịkwa akara aka m aka, eguzosikwara m ike n'okwukwe m ọbụlagodi mgbe a na-eyi m egwu.
Abụ m onye a na-asọpụrụ aha ya na Quran dị ka ihe nlereanya nke okwukwe, ebikwara m n'obí Fero n'onwe ya.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
